newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares extend slight fall in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares extend slight fall in lower trade.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Polish shares extended Tuesday's slight fall but turnover was lower and buying stronger after price-fixing. * The main market's WIG index fell 21.3 points, or 0.1 percent, to 15,066.6, the WIG 20 fell 0.8 percent to 1,481.6 and the parallel market's WIRR rose 0.2 percent to 3,484.4. * Turnover fell 9.2 percent to 192.4 million zlotys on both markets as 40 issues rose, 39 fell and 30 were flat. * The National Investment Fund NIF index fell 1.8 percent to 136.5 points in a turnover of 13.3 million zlotys. NFI units were flat at 138 zlotys in a turnover of 14.5 million zlotys.
